issue.title: Support SES S/MIME signing with ACM certificates (`AssociateEmailIdentityCertificate` / `MessageSecurityOptions`)
issue.body:
### What new functionality are you requesting?

* `aws_sesv2_email_identity_certificate` (new resource, or new attribute block on `aws_sesv2_email_identity`)
* `aws_sesv2_configuration_set` (enhancement — new `message_security_options` argument)

### Description

Amazon SES now supports S/MIME signing of outbound email using X.509 certificates managed in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). This has two parts, both currently unsupported by the provider:

1. Associating an ACM certificate with an email identity's From address, via the `AssociateEmailIdentityCertificate` / `DisassociateEmailIdentityCertificate` / `ListEmailIdentityCertificates` SES v2 API operations (equivalent to `aws sesv2 associate-email-identity-certificate`). There is currently no Terraform resource to manage this association.
2. Enabling S/MIME signing on a configuration set via `UpdateConfigurationSet` with a `MessageSecurityOptions` object (equivalent to `aws sesv2 update-configuration-set --message-security-options '{"SigningScheme":{"Smime":{}}}'`). `aws_sesv2_configuration_set` has no `message_security_options` argument today.

Without these, S/MIME/ACM signing for SES can only be configured out-of-band via the AWS CLI/API, outside of Terraform-managed state.

### Potential Terraform Configuration

```hcl
resource "aws_sesv2_email_identity_certificate" "example" {
  email_identity  = aws_sesv2_email_identity.example.email_identity
  from_address    = "sender@example.com"
  certificate_arn = aws_acm_certificate.smime.arn
}

resource "aws_sesv2_configuration_set" "example" {
  configuration_set_name = "example"

  message_security_options {
    signing_scheme = "SMIME"
  }
}
```

### References

* AWS SDK for Go v2: [`AssociateEmailIdentityCertificate`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sesv2#Client.AssociateEmailIdentityCertificate) (added in SDK v1.71.0)
* AWS docs: [Authenticating email with S/MIME in Amazon SES](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-authentication-smime.html)
* AWS docs: [Attaching a certificate to an email identity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-authentication-smime-associate.html)
* AWS docs: [Enabling S/MIME signing on a configuration set](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-authentication-smime-enable.html)
* AWS CLI: [`associate-email-identity-certificate`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/sesv2/associate-email-identity-certificate.html), [`update-configuration-set`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/sesv2/update-configuration-set.html)

### Would you like to implement the enhancement?

No
